        ### Question
        We have two tests to diagnose a serious prognosis disease. Test A has a sensitivity of 95% and a specificity of 60% and test B has a sensitivity of 70% and a specificity of 99%. We have an effective treatment but that produces important adverse effects and also has a very high cost. What test would we choose to make the diagnosis?

opb. Test A because it has a higher sensitivity.
opc. Test B because it will detect more false positives.
opd. Test A because it will detect more false negatives.
ope. Test B because it has a greater specificity.
